name: Cliamp
author: GM
description: Cliamp in the Omarchy bar: now playing with album art, transport, output routing, and whether the signal reaching the DAC is bit-perfect.

barWidget.description: What is playing, where it is routed, and whether it is bit-perfect.

schema.label: Match the audio graph rate to the track
schema.description: Retunes PipeWire to the track's sample rate while cliamp plays, and restores it afterwards. Affects every application on this machine while music is playing.

schema.label: Relaunch cliamp at the track's native sample rate
schema.description: cliamp fixes its output rate at launch and cannot follow a file, so playing hi-res natively means restarting it. Off by default: the restart gaps the audio, and since cliamp cannot seek a stream, a Navidrome queue comes back at its first track. Works with the panel closed: turning it on keeps the status poll running so the rate follows every track change.

schema.label: Lyric timing trim in milliseconds
schema.description: PipeWire reports the latency up to the radio, and that much is already subtracted. A headset buffers beyond it where the host cannot measure, so add more here if lyrics still run ahead of what you hear.

schema.label: Hide the icon when cliamp is not running
Path to cliamp
schema.description: Leave empty to find cliamp on PATH.
